que_es: A savings account that pays interest and lets you take your money out whenever you like.
rendiment: Low and variable: the bank can change it. The high rate often only lasts a few months or comes with a cap on the amount.
liquiditat: Instant: the money is always available.
costos: Usually none, though sometimes you're asked to have your salary or bills paid through the account.
fiscalitat: Interest is taxed as savings income under Spain's personal income tax (IRPF), at 19% to 30% depending on how much you earn in a year. The bank withholds 19% up front.
garantia: Spain's Deposit Guarantee Fund: up to €100,000 per person, per bank.
per_a_qui: Your emergency cushion: the money you might need tomorrow.
compte_amb: If the interest rate is lower than inflation, you still lose purchasing power.

que_es: You leave your money with the bank for a fixed period (3, 6 or 12 months, for example) in exchange for an agreed interest rate.
rendiment: Fixed for the term. It's linked to ECB rates: when they rise, deposits pay more.
liquiditat: Your money is locked in until maturity; taking it out early may carry a penalty.
fiscalitat: Interest is taxed as savings income under IRPF (19% to 30% depending on how much you earn in a year). The bank withholds 19% up front.
garantia: Spain's Deposit Guarantee Fund: up to €100,000 per person, per bank.
per_a_qui: Money you know you won't need for a set period and want to lock in a rate for.
compte_amb: Look at the APR (TAE), not the nominal rate, and watch out for automatic renewal at a worse rate.

que_es: Short-term loans to the Spanish state: 3, 6, 9 or 12 months.
rendiment: Whatever each auction sets. Check the latest in Your wallet.
liquiditat: You get your money back at maturity. You can sell them earlier on the market, but the price may vary.
costos: None if you buy them directly from the Spanish Treasury (Tesoro Público), online with a digital certificate or at the Bank of Spain (Banco de España); banks may charge fees.
fiscalitat: The gain is taxed as savings income. There's no withholding: you declare it in the following year's tax return.
per_a_qui: Very safe short-term savings, as an alternative to deposits.
compte_amb: The minimum purchase is €1,000. And if inflation is higher than the interest rate, you still lose purchasing power.

que_es: Longer-term loans to the state (from 3 to 30 years) that pay you a fixed interest every year, called the coupon.
rendiment: Usually higher than Treasury bills, and more so the longer the term.
liquiditat: If you hold until maturity, you get back what you put in. If you sell earlier, the price may be higher or lower.
costos: None through the Tesoro Público; fees if you go through a bank.
fiscalitat: Coupons are taxed as savings income, with 19% withheld.
per_a_qui: People who want a regular income and can wait until maturity.
compte_amb: Interest rate risk: if rates rise, older bonds are worth less, and if you have to sell early you could lose money.

que_es: A pot of money from many savers that a manager invests in shares, bonds or both.
rendiment: Depends on what's inside: a bond fund moves little; an equity fund can rise or fall a lot in a year.
liquiditat: You can get your money back within a few days.
costos: An annual management fee deducted from the fund's value; for actively managed funds it's often over 1% a year.
fiscalitat: In Spain you can switch from one fund to another without paying tax (a 'traspaso'). You're only taxed when you take the money out: the gain counts as savings income, with 19% withheld.
per_a_qui: People who want to invest without picking companies one by one.
compte_amb: Fees: 1.5% a year over 20 years eats up a very large share of your gains. Always read the key information document (KID).

que_es: A fund that doesn't try to beat the market but to copy it: it buys every company in an index, such as the S&P 500 or the MSCI World.
rendiment: The return of the market it tracks, minus very low fees. Over the long run, global stocks have historically returned more than deposits, but with years of falls of 20% or more.
liquiditat: You can get your money back within a few days.
costos: Very low: often under 0.3% a year.
fiscalitat: Like any fund: tax-free switching, and you're taxed when you take the money out.
per_a_qui: Long-term savings (more than 5 or 10 years) for people who want broad diversification at low cost.
compte_amb: It's not for money you might need soon: in a bad patch it can fall sharply and take years to recover.

que_es: Like an index fund, but bought and sold on the stock market, like a share, at the current price.
rendiment: The return of the index it tracks, minus low fees.
liquiditat: You can sell whenever the stock market is open.
costos: A low annual fee plus the broker's fee on every purchase or sale.
fiscalitat: In Spain they can't be switched tax-free: every sale at a profit is taxed as savings income.
per_a_qui: People who want to invest in indices through a broker.
compte_amb: Buying and selling often multiplies the fees and the taxes.

que_es: Buying a piece of a specific company and becoming a part-owner.
rendiment: Can be very high or very negative: a company can double in value or lose almost all of it. Some pay dividends.
liquiditat: They sell on the stock market in seconds, at the current price.
costos: A broker's or bank's fee on every trade, and sometimes a custody fee.
fiscalitat: Dividends have 19% withheld; the gain when you sell counts as savings income.
per_a_qui: People who want to follow specific companies, with money they can afford to see fall.
compte_amb: Putting all your money into a few companies multiplies the risk: diversifying is the basic rule.

que_es: A product for saving for retirement, which a provider invests in bonds, shares or both.
rendiment: Depends on what's inside; fees are usually higher than for index funds.
liquiditat: The money is locked away until retirement, except in cases such as long-term unemployment, serious illness or contributions made more than 10 years ago.
fiscalitat: Contributions (up to €1,500 a year in a personal plan) are deducted from your IRPF taxable income. When you take the money out, it's taxed as if it were salary.
per_a_qui: People who pay a high rate of income tax now and expect to pay a lower one in retirement.
compte_amb: It's not a tax gift but a deferral: the tax is paid at the end. And for a young person, having money locked away for decades is a cost.

que_es: Digital currencies, like bitcoin, that don't depend on any central bank or government.
rendiment: Extremely volatile: they can rise or fall by more than 50% in a few months.
liquiditat: They can be sold at any time on exchanges, but the price may be very different from yesterday's.
fiscalitat: The gain when you sell them, or swap them for another cryptocurrency, is taxed as savings income.
per_a_qui: Only with money you can afford to lose entirely.
compte_amb: There's no guarantee fund: if the exchange goes bust or you lose your keys, you can lose everything. Watch out for scams.
